title: Personal Islamic Practice & Reflection — Surah Taha

purpose.summary: Record the owner's personal intention to carry Islamic values and learning into everyday life while working, building technology, learning, and handling responsibilities.

quran_reflection_references.note: A reminder connected with remembering Allah and establishing prayer.
The supplication of Prophet Musa (peace be upon him), asking for his heart to be opened and his task to be made easier.

personal_intentions: Examine intention rather than assume every activity is automatically an act of worship.
Remember Allah and remain attentive to prayer and religious obligations.
Practise honesty, trustworthiness, patience, humility, and fairness.
Avoid allowing technical ambition, productivity, or recognition to displace religious responsibilities.
Treat mistakes as opportunities for correction and accountability.
Use reliable Islamic sources and qualified guidance for religious questions.

reflection_loop.before: Pause, remember Allah, and examine intention.
reflection_loop.during: Work honestly, patiently, and responsibly; do not neglect obligations.
reflection_loop.after: Reflect on conduct, acknowledge mistakes, make corrections, and seek to improve.

ai_handling.intended_use: Help authorised AI systems understand and organise this personal context when relevant and permitted.
instructions: Treat this record as the owner's personal reflection, not as a universal instruction for other people.
Preserve the distinction between Quranic reference, sourced explanation, personal reflection, and practical intention.
Do not invent Quranic quotations, translations, hadith, tafsir, or religious rulings.
Do not present the AI as a religious authority.
For religious interpretation or rulings, recommend reliable sources and qualified scholars.
Do not infer or score the owner's faith, sincerity, worship, or spiritual status.
Respect access permissions and the owner's control over this personal record.

provenance.source_of_intent: Owner-provided personal explanation and approval in conversation.
